# ELECTE Tools — catalog

<!-- Generated by electe-web/scripts/export-tools-repo.ts. Do not edit here: change the source in electe-migration and re-export. -->

41 tools on [tools.electe.net](https://tools.electe.net): 29 calculators (a formula, in your browser), 3 browser data tools (a table or a series in, a chart or a file out) and 9 model-backed tools (a language model reads what you wrote; see [docs/ai-tools.md](docs/ai-tools.md)). Every page exists in 21 languages with its own slug; the links below are English and Italian, and `catalog.json` carries all 21.
